HARI PRASAD

Trade Settlements | Cash Reconciliation | Capital Markets Operations

Phone: 7676606483 Email: hariprasadgatti1992@gmail.com

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

Capital Markets Operations professional with 7.5 years of experience in Trade Settlements and Cash & Nostro Reconciliation across global markets. Strong expertise in pre-matching, SSI validation, fail trade investigation, buy-in risk mitigation, and T+1 settlement cycles. Proven track record in reducing settlement failures, improving operational efficiency, and delivering automation initiatives that reduced manual effort by 70%.

CORE SKILLS

Trade Settlements, Trade Life Cycle Management, T+1 Settlement Processing, Pre-Matching, Fail Trade Investigation, Buy-In Risk Management, SSI Validation, Settlement Exception Management, Stock & Trade Break Investigation, Cash & Nostro Reconciliation, Break Resolution, Counterparty Management, SWIFT MT540–MT544, CTM (Omgeo), Euroclear Operations, Risk & Controls, Stakeholder Management, Process Improvement, MIS Reporting, Advanced Excel

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Société Générale – Senior Analyst, Trade Settlements (Aug 2023 – Dec 2025)

Managed end-to-end trade settlements across Euroclear markets, ensuring timely settlement within T+1 settlement cycles. • Performed proactive pre-matching with counterparties to facilitate timely settlement. • Monitored buy-in risk exposures and initiated timely escalations. • Investigated failed trades and coordinated with Front Office, Middle Office, and counterparties. • Monitored failed trades on a daily basis, performed root cause analysis, and updated failure reasons in internal systems. • Performed SSI validation and ensured accurate settlement instructions for trade processing. • Conducted stock and trade break investigations to identify root causes and ensure timely resolution. • Liaised with counterparties and internal teams to ensure smooth and timely settlement of trades. • Ensured compliance with market deadlines, regulatory requirements, and internal controls. • Prepared daily MIS reports and provided updates on settlement risks and aged fails. • Resolved settlement exceptions through timely follow-up with internal teams and counterparties. • Collaborated with global teams to ensure timely settlement and resolution of trade exceptions. Accenture – Analyst, Cash Reconciliation (May 2019 – Aug 2023)

Performed daily multi-currency cash & nostro reconciliations across global accounts. • Investigated and resolved cash breaks through root cause analysis. • Delivered automation initiatives that reduced manual effort by 70%. • Participated in UAT testing and coordinated with IT teams for issue resolution.

Deutsche Bank – Analyst, Trade Settlements (2018 – 2019)

Supported trade settlements across the full trade life cycle. • Performed pre-matching and validated settlement instructions. • Coordinated with counterparties for timely settlement resolution.

EDUCATION

MBA (Finance) – Bangalore University B.Com (Accounts) – Andhra University

TOOLS & SYSTEMS

CTM / Omgeo | Euroclear | SWIFT MT540–MT544 | Reconciliation Systems | Bank Settlement Platforms | Advanced Excel
